final: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), threshold AS (SELECT 1.0 * SUM(order_count) / (SELECT COUNT(account_id) FROM account) AS avg_per_account FROM order_counts), kept AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count, oc.order_count - t.avg_per_account AS excess FROM order_counts AS oc CROSS JOIN threshold AS t WHERE oc.order_count > t.avg_per_account), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count FROM kept) SELECT k.account_id, k.order_count, k.excess, k.order_count - ka.avg_order_count FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_average AS ka WHERE ka.avg_order_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY k.order_count - ka.avg_order_count DESC LIMIT 10
